event.text: I recommend an in-person assessment today for this new chest pain — somewhere that can check your vital signs, examine your heart and lungs, and do an ECG and further testing if indicated. Your heavy workout makes a chest wall strain possible, but it doesn't confirm it, and that can't be sorted out by message. If no such visit is available promptly today, go to an emergency department. Go to emergency care now if you develop shortness of breath, fainting, coughing blood, sweating, or crushing/pressure-type chest pain. Counsel can stay involved in this thread, but I can't book or confirm any visit.
